name: n*400>=area -> n*400>area
code: public boolean hasEnoughPaint(int n){double area=0;for(Surface s:surfaceArray)area+=s.getWidth()*s.getLength();return n*400>area;}

name: g.getHomeScore()>g.getAwayScore() -> g.getHomeScore()>=g.getAwayScore()
code: public int getLongestHomeWinStreak(){int best=0,n=0;for(Game g:allGames){if(g.getHomeScore()>=g.getAwayScore())n++;else n=0;best=Math.max(best,n);}return best;}

name: chart[br][bc]=null; ->
code: public void upgrade(int r,int c){int br=-1,bc=-1,best=-1;for(int i=r+1;i<chart.length;i++)for(int j=0;j<chart[i].length;j++)if(chart[i][j]!=null&&chart[i][j].getRating()>best){best=chart[i][j].getRating();br=i;bc=j;}chart[r][c]=chart[br][bc];}

name: m<60 -> m<59
code: public int findFreeBlock(int p,int d){int n=0;for(int m=0;m<59;m++){if(isMinuteFree(p,m))n++;else n=0;if(n==d)return m-d+1;}return -1;}public boolean makeAppointment(int s,int e,int d){for(int p=s;p<=e;p++){int m=findFreeBlock(p,d);if(m>=0){reserveBlock(p,m,d);return true;}}return false;}

name: simulateOneDay(n); -> simulateOneDay(1);
code: public void simulateOneDay(int n){if(Math.random()<.95){int each=(int)(Math.random()*41)+10;currentFood=Math.max(0,currentFood-n*each);}else currentFood=0;}public int simulateManyDays(int n,int days){int d=0;while(d<days&&currentFood>0){simulateOneDay(1);d++;}return d;}
